allot.text: Qualified institutions placement of equity shares of face value Rs. 10 each  for an amount aggregating to Rs. 1,000 crore (the  Equity Shares ) by Syrma SGS Technology Limited (the  Company ) under the provisions of Chapter VI of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, as amended (the  SEBI ICDR Regulations ), and Sections 42, 23(1)(b) and 62(1)(c) of the Companies Act, 2013, including the rules made thereunder, each as amended (the  Issue ).
